rules: reduce(def, events) deep-equals <name>.state.json; def = <name>.def.json; events = the parsed lines of <name>.jsonl
the hash chain is valid: seq 0..n, prev = sha256 hex of the previous line's bytes (without its \n), "" at seq 0; corruption vectors live in S1's tests

vectors.name: 01-created
vectors.description: created only: every chain AWAITING_KEY, job DEFINED

vectors.name: 02-ready
vectors.description: lease, key-loaded, funds affordable: READY

vectors.name: 03-armed
vectors.description: armed: chain ARMED, job ARMED, releaseAt set

vectors.name: 04-intent
vectors.description: one open intent: RUNNING, openIntents [t1], resume at copy 1 part 1

vectors.name: 05a-copies-done
vectors.description: copies 1: intent, sent, included, readback, reassembled, copies-done: COPIES_DONE; job stays ARMED (settled, not closed)

vectors.name: 05b-closed
vectors.description: copies 1 settled, then close: DONE; job DONE

vectors.name: 06-eth-replacement
vectors.description: same-nonce replacement: a2 included, a1 superseded; no readback yet so resume stays at part 1

vectors.name: 07-sol-expired
vectors.description: SOL s1 proven expired (reconcile), s2 re-signed and included with readback: copy complete

vectors.name: 08-takeover
vectors.description: gen 1 intent sent, lease expired, gen 2 acquired by cli: t1 stays open until reconciled

vectors.name: 09a-stuck
vectors.description: sent outcome unknown, then stuck: STUCK overrides RUNNING; the intent stays open

vectors.name: 09b-resolved
vectors.description: stuck, then resolved mark-done: RUNNING; the attempt counts as landed (no block, fee or readback); spent counts its worst case, gas × maxFee (CC-2a: the journal has no fee, never 0)

vectors.name: 10a-paused
vectors.description: drain copy 1 complete, then paused at the tip cap: PAUSED

vectors.name: 10b-resumed
vectors.description: paused, resume-requested, resumed: RUNNING

vectors.name: 11-drained
vectors.description: drain: copy 1 complete, the next copy unaffordable (drained.copy = that next copy): DRAINED; job ARMED

vectors.name: 12-clawback
vectors.description: drained, then claw-back intent/sent/included/readback: CLAWED_BACK; spent includes the claw-back fee; job DONE

vectors.name: 13-resume-part
vectors.description: R72: copy 1 (5 parts) complete; copy 2 parts 1-3 included + read back, part 4 intent open: resume {copy 2, nextPart 4}

vectors.name: 14-stopped
vectors.description: stop-requested before any intent, the API journals stopped (code operator-stop): STOPPED, resumable; a STOPPED chain is not terminal → job ARMED (final round F18-2; the key stays busy until close)

vectors.name: 15a-skipped
vectors.description: job with eth + sol, armed with eth only: sol SKIPPED (terminal, no funds touched); job ARMED

vectors.name: 15b-skipped-done
vectors.description: eth copies 1 done and closed, sol SKIPPED: job DONE

vectors.name: 16-sol-late-landing
vectors.description: CC-2a chain evidence wins: s1 journaled expired, s2 re-signed, then s1 included: s1 lands, s2 superseded, s1's fee spent, the part is complete (never sent again)

vectors.name: 17a-clawback-bump-earlier-lands
vectors.description: CC-2a family: claw-back c1, then its same-nonce bump c2; c1 lands: the claw-back shows c1 (its value), landed, CLAWED_BACK; c2 closed; job DONE

vectors.name: 17b-clawback-all-dead
vectors.description: CC-2a family (E2 re-review D-2): c1 reconciled nonce-consumed, c2 stuck (STUCK) then resolved mark-failed by the operator: every member dead and none landed → the claw-back fails by itself (ok false, back to DRAINED, nothing open)

vectors.name: 17c-clawback-failed-on-chain
vectors.description: CC-2a: a claw-back that failed ON CHAIN: clawback-failed carries the fee charged (spent); back to DRAINED, ok false, not landed
